description: SG90 servo sweep: TIM2 CH1 PA0 50 Hz, 0.5-2.5 ms pulses, 0 -> 180 -> 0 deg in 30 deg steps every 500 ms, USART1 log
expect:
72 MHz; TIM2 PSC 71 (1 us per count), ARR 19999: a rising edge on PA0 (AF push-pull) every 20.000 ms (50 Hz), PWM mode 1, pulse = CCR1 us, preloaded. USART1 PA9/PA10 115200 8N1 sends 'SG90 sweep 0-180 deg
' and 'servo 0 deg (500 us)
', then every 500 ms (HAL_GetTick deadlines, no drift) the next 30 deg step 'servo <a> deg (<us> us)
' with a = 30, 60, ..., 180, 150, ..., 0, 30, ... and us = 500 + a*2000/180 rounded (833, 1167, 1500, 1833, 2167, 2500). An SG90 on PA0 (VCC 5 V) follows: 0.5 ms = 0 deg, 2.5 ms = 180 deg, about 50 ms per 30 deg step at 4.8 V.

circuit: PA0: SG90 SIG (or a logic analyzer probe); the servo angle itself is covered by tests/devices/motors-firmware.test.ts
USART1: virtual terminal on PA9 (TX) / PA10 (RX)

boot.USART1:
SG90 sweep 0-180 deg
servo 0 deg (500 us)
